stem: 下列关于学术研究报告摘要(Abstract)结构特征的表述，最不准确的一项是：
options: A. 摘要通常按目的—方法—结果—结论的顺序组织。
B. 摘要末尾常附3~5个关键词便于检索。
C. 摘要语言追求精确、客观，避免使用主观评价词。
D. 摘要应以第一人称叙述研究者的个人感受与心路历程。
solution: 摘要通常依次呈现研究目的、方法、主要结果与结论。A项目的—方法—结果—结论是IMRaD摘要的常见模板；B项关键词常置于摘要末尾便于检索；C项语言精确、客观，避免主观评价；D项用第一人称叙述研究者的个人感受是科普随笔特征，非学术摘要规范。故选D。

stem: 阅读一段关于海洋微塑料污染的学术摘要：This study investigates the distribution of microplastics (<5 mm) in surface waters of the South China Sea. Samples were collected from 24 sites... Polyethylene and polypropylene accounted for 78% of the particles. Concentrations were highest near coastal cities. The results suggest that land-based sources are the major origin of microplastic pollution. 该摘要未明确给出哪一部分？
options: A. 采样时间与网具孔径等方法细节。
B. 研究区域(南海)的空间范围。
C. 主要污染物成分(聚乙烯、聚丙烯)。
D. 污染来源的初步推断。
solution: 摘要已呈现目的investigates、结果78% highest和结论suggest；未出现方法细节如采样时间、网具孔径的具体参数。A项采样时间与网具孔径属Methods部分的具体细节，最可能缺失；故选A。

stem: 假设你作为研究小组的一员，要评价上题摘要所述研究的结论是否严谨。请写出3条评价角度(不超过50词)。
answer: 1)样本量与代表性:24个站点能否代表整个南海?2)相关vs因果:78%占比不能直接推断陆地是主要来源,还需考虑洋流作用。3)时空局限:仅表层、短期采样不能反映垂直分布与季节差异,需结合长期监测。
solution: 本题考查对学术研究报告结论严谨性的评价能力。需从样本代表性、相关与因果、时空局限等维度切入,参考答案列出三个角度,每点均可从摘要中找出对应依据。
writing_prompt: 假设你作为研究小组的一员，要评价上题摘要所述研究的结论是否严谨。请写出3条评价角度(不超过50词)。

stem: 下列句子中,重音位置不同会改变表达意图:I didn't say he stole the money. 若要强调是别人偷的而非我所说,核心重音应落在______上。
solution: 原句若重读he,强调是他而不是别人偷了钱;如要强调我没有说(是别人说的),则重读didn't。本题要求强化是别人偷的,故核心重音落在he上。

stem: 演讲结尾Never, never, never give up.中连续重复never主要起到的修辞作用是：
options: A. 表示对未来的迷茫。
B. 增强否定语气,形成层递修辞。
C. 暗示对听众的讽刺与批评。
D. 引出下文的对比论证。
solution: 重复同一否定词never三次构成排比与层递,强化否定语气,凸显不屈意志。B项增强语气、形成层递最准确;A项偏弱;C、D项不符合语境(无讽刺,无对比对象)。故选B。

stem: 下列单词均出自高中选必阶段词汇表,其中词义与搭配均恰当的一项是：
options: A. The book lay on the shelf for years, laying forgotten.
B. His sudden affect surprised the whole class.
C. The scientist explained the principle behind the phenomenon clearly.
D. She is the principle of our school and a kind person.
solution: A项lay与lie混搭,搭配错误;B项affect多用作动词影响,作名词仅在心理学中表示情感,用于日常语境不当;D项principle与principal同音异义,原理应为principle,而校长是principal,混用错误。故选C。

stem: 根据句意与汉语提示填空:The professor gave a ____ (全面的) overview of recent developments in AI.
solution: comprehensive意为全面的、综合的,作定语修饰overview。注意不要误用为comprehensible(可理解的)。

stem: 下列句子中,划线词用法与其它三项不同的是：
options: A. She showed great courage when facing the danger.
B. The book aroused my interest in history.
C. They expressed their satisfaction with the result.
D. The knife has a sharp edge.
solution: A、B、C三项划线词均为抽象名词作动词宾语;D项a sharp中sharp是形容词作定语修饰名词。词性不同,故选D。

stem: 用括号内所给词的适当形式填空:His ____ (argue) that the policy was unfair convinced the committee.
solution: 作主语须用动名词形式arguing,意为他关于政策不公平的争论说服了委员会。

stem: 下列习语/俚语与其英语释义匹配正确的一项是：
options: A. break the ice: to do or say something to reduce tension or get conversation going in a social situation
B. cost an arm and a leg: to cost very little and be affordable
C. once in a blue moon: very often, almost every day
D. hit the books: to throw books at someone in anger
solution: A项break the ice意为打破沉默、活跃气氛,搭配正确;B项cost an arm and a leg应指非常昂贵,而非价格适中;C项once in a blue moon意为极少、难得,而非经常;D项hit the books意为用功读书,而非扔书。故选A。

stem: 用恰当的习语填空:When the negotiation reached a ______ (僵局), the mediator proposed a break.
solution: deadlock与stalemate均可表示僵局,常与reach / hit / end in搭配。deadlock多用于谈判、讨论;stalemate多用于博弈、棋局。

stem: 下列不属于environment/sustainability(语义场)的一组词是：
options: A. emission / carbon footprint / pollutant
B. habitat / biodiversity / ecosystem
C. conserve / recycle / renewable
D. strength / weakness / courage
solution: A、B、C三项分别与排放、栖息地、节能相关,属于环境/可持续语义场;D项strength / weakness / courage属于性格特征语义场。故选D。

stem: 请围绕英语科学主题列出5个语义场相关词块(中文+英文)。
answer: 1) hypothesis 假设;2) conduct an experiment 做实验;3) collect data 收集数据;4) draw a conclusion 得出结论;5) peer review 同行评审
solution: 本题考查科学主题语境下词块的成组调用能力。需调用假设-实验-数据-结论-评审这一完整科学流程的词块,且每条至少包含一个动作或核心名词,避免仅给孤立单词。

stem: 在给校长的正式信函中,下列开头最得体的一项是：
options: A. Hey Mr. Smith, how's it going?
B. Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to request...
C. Mr. Smith 你好:
D. Hi Smith,
solution: B项Dear Mr. Smith礼貌正式,符合对外信函规范;A项过于亲昵;C项中文式称呼;D项不够正式。故选B。

stem: 将下列口语化句子改写为正式书面语(30词以内):The kids went nuts when they saw the surprise party.
answer: The children were utterly delighted / overjoyed upon seeing the surprise party arranged in their honour.
solution: 口语went nuts改为were utterly delighted/overjoyed;kids改为children;saw改为合适依据,arranged in their honour体现书面正式语体。

stem: 他是个老好人。译成英语时,最恰当的表达是：
options: A. He is a pushover.
B. He is a kind old man.
C. He is a fool.
D. He is a good guy.
solution: 老好人含贬义,指对谁都迁就、不得罪的人;A项a pushover意为容易被说服/利用的人,贴合贬义色彩;B项a kind old man是褒义;D项a good guy也偏褒义;C项a fool与语义不符。故选A。

stem: 将中文句子他的成功一半靠努力,一半靠运气意译为地道英文(不超过25词)。
answer: His success owes as much to his persistent effort as to sheer luck.
solution: 直译为His success half depends on effort and half on luck较生硬。owes...to句式归功于/得益于,as much to A as to B表A和B同等重要,更地道。

stem: 下列关于英语语法体系特征的表述,最准确的一项是：
options: A. 英语语法主要靠语序,不依赖形态变化。
B. 英语重形合,多借助连接词、从句与形态变化;汉语重意合,常以短句叠加表达逻辑。
C. 英语的语序完全固定,永远不允许倒装。
D. 英语语篇几乎不使用被动语态。
solution: A项混淆语法与修辞;B项英语重形合(借助连接词、形态变化等显性手段),重主语凸显,与汉语重意合形成对比,符合学界共识;C项过度绝对化;D项几乎不用被动错误,被动语态在英语中频繁使用。故选B。

stem: 用所给词的适当形式填空:If I ______ (be) you, I would take the opportunity immediately.
solution: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句,be动词在主语为第一人称时用were,而非was。

stem: 完成倒装句:______ (Not until he returned) did I realize how much I had missed him.
solution: 否定词not until / hardly / scarcely / never / neither等位于句首,主句用部分倒装。本题already给出Not until he returned,待下一复述结构不变。

stem: 下列句子使用全部倒装(all-inversion)的是：
options: A. There stood an old temple at the top of the hill.
B. Hardly had I fallen asleep when the phone rang.
C. Only then did I understand the importance of honesty.
D. Not only does he speak French, but also he speaks German.
solution: A项There stood an old temple是全倒装;B、C、D项用部分倒装did / will / had。故选A。

stem: 用倒装结构改写下列句子,保持原意:The villagers had no sooner heard the news than they rushed out.
answer: No sooner had the villagers heard the news than they rushed out.
solution: no sooner...than...句型中,no sooner提前需主句部分倒装had + 主语 + 过去分词。than分句保持陈述语序。

stem: 下列对强调句It was his hard work that led to his success.的判断,最准确的一项是：
options: A. 这是定语从句,his hard work是先行词。
B. 这是强调句,被强调部分是his hard work。
C. 这句强调的是动词led。
D. 强调人必须用who,不能用that。
solution: B项是典型It is/was...that...强调句结构,强调主语his hard work,可还原为His hard work led to his success;A项混淆强调句与定语从句;C项错误强调动词;D项错误认为只能用who。故选B。

stem: 用强调句改写:My teacher inspired me to pursue biology. → ______
answer: It was my teacher who/that inspired me to pursue biology.
solution: 强调主语my teacher用It is/was + 被强调部分 + who/that + 其余。若强调宾语me则It was me that my teacher inspired...。

stem: 下列含有同位语从句的一项是：
options: A. The fact that he had won the prize surprised everyone.
B. The news that he told us was unbelievable.
C. I believe that he is honest.
D. She said that she would come.
solution: A项fact后that从句解释fact的具体内容,是同位语从句;B项the news后为定语从句(缺主语,that=the news);C、D项that在句中作宾语,是宾语从句。故选A。

stem: 填空:The proposal ______ (that) they put forward was finally accepted.
solution: the proposal后定语从句(put forward缺宾语),用that/which引导。此处亦可填which。

stem: 下列if虚拟语气从句使用正确的一项是：
options: A. If I have more time, I would have helped you.
B. If he was rich, he would travel around the world.
C. If I had known the news earlier, I would have called you.
D. If it will rain tomorrow, we would stay at home.
solution: C项与过去事实相反,主句would have done,从句had done;A项would + 现在完成时不应与if did搭配;B项be在主语为单数第一/第三人称时应用were;D项错把if真实条件句与虚拟混用。故选C。

stem: 填空:If I ______ (have) wings, I would fly to see you right now.
solution: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件,从句用一般过去时had(be用were)。

stem: 下列省略结构使用不恰当的一项是：
options: A. He didn't come, but he should have (come).
B. — Do you know him? — Yes, I do (know him).
C. While (the car) the traffic light was red, the car stopped.
D. She works harder than (she) used to (work).
solution: C项将状语从句中的助动词省略,造成歧义;A、B、D项均为常见省略(动词不定式、宾语、主语)且语义完整。故选C。

stem: 填空完成省略句:— Are you coming? — I hope ______ (to).
solution: hope后省略come,整句为I hope to (come)。

stem: 下列分词作状语使用错误的一项是：
options: A. Being tired, he went to bed early. (表原因)
B. Having finished the homework, I went out to play. (表时间)
C. He sat there, reading a book. (表伴随)
D. Having lost the key, the door couldn't be opened.
solution: D项Having finished逻辑主语应与if主语一致,且时态不匹配;A、B、C项分词状语使用正确。A项表原因;B项表时间;C项表伴随。故选D。

stem: 用独立主格结构填空:The weather ______ (permit), we will go hiking tomorrow.
solution: Weather与permit构成逻辑主谓关系,独立主格结构作条件状语,用现在分词permitting。

stem: 下列复合句结构最复杂、最符合学术语体的一项是：
options: A. He works hard. He gets good grades.
B. If you study hard, you will succeed.
C. The teacher came in. The students stood up.
D. The hypothesis that the researchers proposed, which had been debated for years, was finally verified by the data collected from a cohort of 500 participants.
solution: D项使用嵌套定语从句+介词短语+非谓语,结构严密,符合学术语体;A、B项为简单复合句;C项结构较松散。故选D。

stem: 将两个简单句合并为含非谓语的复合句:He had finished the report. He handed it to the manager.
answer: Having finished the report, he handed it to the manager.
solution: 用现在分词完成式Having finished...作时间状语,主句he handed it...表达后续动作。

stem: 关于社论(editorial)的写作目的与结构,下列表述最准确的一项是：
options: A. 社论旨在论证观点,结构上常采用提出议题—表明立场—论证—总结呼吁。
B. 社论主要传递信息、记录事件,属于新闻报道。
C. 社论以客观说明事物特征为目的,属说明文。
D. 社论以个人经历与感受为主要内容,属记叙文。
solution: A项社论的核心目的是论证观点,常采用现象-观点-论证-结论的四段式;B、C项混淆社论与新闻报道、说明文;D项以个人经历为主是叙事文特征。故选A。

stem: 假设你是校报编辑,需写一篇关于高中生使用手机时长的社论(80词以内)。请列出三点支持限制时长的论据。
answer: 1)影响课堂专注:数据显示上课使用手机的学生课堂参与度下降约30%。2)损害视力与睡眠:长期盯着屏幕导致近视率上升、晚间拖延影响次日精力。3)削弱深度思考:碎片化信息接收降低长时间阅读与独立思考能力。呼吁学校出台合理制度、家长以身作则。
solution: 本题要求运用社论分论点—论据—呼吁结构。三个论据分别从学习、健康、思维品质切入,体现逻辑推进;最后以呼吁收尾,形成完整社论骨架。
writing_prompt: 假设你是校报编辑,需写一篇关于高中生使用手机时长的社论(80词以内)。请列出三点支持限制时长的论据。

stem: 下列句子中,没有使用but / however等显性转折词,却实现了隐性转折/对比的一项是：
options: A. He is a student. He studies hard every day.
B. I once believed success meant wealth; now I know it means inner peace.
C. The sun rose. The birds sang.
D. She sings. She is singing now.
solution: B项通过时态对比曾认为... 现在发现...实现隐性转折;A、C、D项均为平铺直叙或并列,无对比关系。故选B。

stem: 用隐性衔接手段补全句子:The room was packed ______ (没有任何空位), yet no one seemed to mind standing.
solution: without any empty seats / with no empty seats均可,表示没有空座位,与后句yet表对比形成隐性转折衔接。

stem: 在求职面试的自我介绍中,下列表达最得体的一项是：
options: A. Hey, I'm Jack. I just love hanging out with people.
B. Good morning. I'm Jack Smith, a graduate of XYZ University with two years' experience in marketing. I excel at data analysis.
C. I like music and playing games. That's all about me.
D. I'm perfect for any job you can imagine.
solution: B项正式、简洁,突出资历与优势,符合面试场景;A项过于随意;C项仅描述兴趣爱好,未扣岗位;D项无所不能过于夸张。故选B。

stem: 假设你要向英国交换生介绍中国春节习俗,请写一段得体的开场白(30词以内)。
answer: Good afternoon, everyone. I'm delighted to share with you the traditions of Chinese New Year — a festival full of reunion, blessings, and rich cultural meaning.
solution: 得体开场白要点:礼貌称呼+自我介绍+话题预告+情感色彩。注意使用Good afternoon / I'm delighted to share等正式表达。
writing_prompt: 假设你要向英国交换生介绍中国春节习俗,请写一段得体的开场白(30词以内)。

stem: 在向教授请求延期交作业的邮件中,下列表达最委婉得体的一项是：
options: A. I wonder if it would be possible to extend the deadline by two days. I would greatly appreciate your understanding.
B. Give me two more days, OK?
C. I can't finish the homework on time. So I want more time.
D. You must give me an extension.
solution: A项使用I wonder if / possibly / I would appreciate三个缓和语,既表达请求又留有余地;B项too直接;D项命令式语气。故选A。

stem: 用模糊语改写下列过绝对句:This is the best method. → ______
answer: This seems / appears to be one of the most effective methods.
solution: 将绝对最高级the best弱化为one of the most...,加seems / appears to be表示主观判断,缓和语气。

stem: 下列关于英美文化特色的表述,最准确的一项是：
options: A. 圣诞节只在美国庆祝,英国不过圣诞节。
B. 感恩节(Thanksgiving)是美国传统节日,火鸡是标志性食物之一。
C. 英国皇室传统在美国文化中具有核心地位。
D. 美国饮食文化单一,以快餐为主。
solution: B项感恩节为美国传统节日,火鸡是其标志性食物;A项圣诞节英国/加拿大也庆祝;C项英国皇室不等于美国文化;D项美国饮食单一过于绝对化。故选B。

stem: 请用英文介绍英国下午茶(afternoon tea)的文化内涵(30词以内)。
answer: Afternoon tea is a British tradition usually taken at 4 pm, featuring tea, scones and sandwiches. It reflects the British value of leisure and refined social interaction.
solution: 需点明时间(4 pm)、内容(tea, scones, sandwiches)与文化内涵(悠闲、社交仪式感)。注意避免中式直译。
writing_prompt: 请用英文介绍英国下午茶(afternoon tea)的文化内涵(30词以内)。

stem: 下列关于马丁·路德·金《我有一个梦想》(I Have a Dream)演讲的表述,最准确的一项是：
options: A. 演讲以学术论证为主,语言克制客观。
B. 演讲通过I have a dream的反复,形成排比与层递,强化对自由平等理想的呼唤。
C. 演讲聚焦经济政策分析,避免政治议题。
D. 演讲为短篇即兴演讲,无重复修辞。
solution: B项我有一个梦想在演讲中多次重复,形成排比与情感层递,是演讲最具感染力的核心修辞;A项混淆主题;C项错把政治演讲混为学术;D项完全不重复错误。故选B。

stem: 请用英文写出你最欣赏的一部文学作品(或名人传记)的核心精神(30词以内)。
answer: Sample: From Charlotte's Web I learnt that sincere friendship and sacrifice can transcend species and time — love makes even the briefest life meaningful.
solution: 回答需点出作品名+核心主题+个人感悟,避免只罗列情节。注意使用learnt/realised等感悟动词。
writing_prompt: 请用英文写出你最欣赏的一部文学作品(或名人传记)的核心精神(30词以内)。

stem: 在向外国友人介绍中国四大发明时,下列英文表述最恰当的一项是：
options: A. The four invent of China is paper, print, gun and compass.
B. The Four Great Inventions of ancient China — papermaking, printing, gunpowder and the compass — have shaped the course of human civilisation.
C. All of China's four inventions were invented by one single person.
D. Foreigners know nothing about China's four inventions.
solution: B项The Four Great Inventions of ancient China — papermaking, printing, gunpowder and the compass — shaped the modern world简洁地道;A项拼写/搭配错误;C项四大发明全部归功于一个发明人错误;D项无人知晓错误。故选B。

stem: 请用英文向国际交换生简要说明一带一路(Belt and Road)倡议的意义(80词以内)。
answer: The Belt and Road Initiative, proposed by China in 2013, aims to enhance connectivity and cooperation across Asia, Europe and Africa. By investing in infrastructure and trade routes, it promotes mutual benefit, cultural exchange, and shared prosperity among partner countries.
solution: 要点:倡议时间(2013)、目的(互联互通、合作)、手段(基础设施+贸易)、意义(互利、文化交流、共同繁荣)。避免政治化表述,用mutual / shared等中性词。
writing_prompt: 请用英文向国际交换生简要说明一带一路(Belt and Road)倡议的意义(80词以内)。

stem: 阅读段落:Though battered by years of criticism, the artist kept creating. Her paintings, once dismissed as childish, now hang in the world's leading museums. 下列对其价值观的阐释最恰当的一项是：
options: A. 艺术家坚守自我、不被外界批评击垮,最终获得认可。
B. 艺术家最终选择迎合批评,改变了创作风格。
C. 艺术家被动接受批评,放弃主动创作。
D. 艺术家放弃创作,转而从事评论。
solution: A项坚持自我、不被外界质疑击垮,最终获得认可贴合段落主旨;B项强调迎合批评,与文中keep creating矛盾;C项错把被动接受当作主旨;D项放弃创作明显错误。故选A。

stem: 请用30词以内阐释上段画线词childish在文中的情感态度。
answer: “Childish” here is dismissive and contemptuous, reflecting critics' initial underestimation of her unconventional style.
solution: 需指出childish一词的贬义、批评者高高在上的态度及对艺术家风格的低估。
writing_prompt: 请用30词以内阐释上段画线词childish在文中的情感态度。

stem: 在纪录片中,画面(田野调查镜头)、旁白(专家解释)与受访者采访共同建构意义。下列关于多模态语篇的表述,最准确的一项是：
options: A. 多模态语篇中,图像、声音、文字等多模态相互补充,共同建构意义。
B. 多模态语篇以文字为主,图像仅为装饰。
C. 各种模态在多模态语篇中互不相关,各自独立。
D. 多模态语篇只用于娱乐节目,不适用于新闻或教育。
solution: A项三种模态互补建构,符合多模态语篇特征;B项以文字为主忽略了图像/声音的协同作用;C项互不相关错误;D项过于绝对化。故选A。

stem: 请举例说明一幅公益海报中图像(visual)与文字(verbal)如何共同建构意义(30词以内)。
answer: Example: A poster showing a parched earth cracking beneath a green seedling, captioned 'Every drop matters' — image and words together amplify the urgency of water conservation.
solution: 要点:描述具体图像(干旱大地+嫩芽)+ 文字标语 + 二者协同效果。注意避免只描述图像或文字。
writing_prompt: 请举例说明一幅公益海报中图像(visual)与文字(verbal)如何共同建构意义(30词以内)。

stem: 阅读:The library was unusually quiet yesterday. Only three students were in the reading room, and two of them were sleeping on the books. 可合理推出的结论是：
options: A. 图书馆昨天临时关门。
B. 可能是考试前一天,无人认真复习。
C. 图书馆座位严重不足。
D. 图书馆禁止学生睡觉。
solution: B项可能是考试前一天,无人认真复习是从事实(异常安静+两人睡觉)推出的合理推断;A、C、D项均超出原文信息(原文未提考试、图书馆关门、座位不足)。故选B。

stem: 阅读:After three months of online learning, the average grade rose from 72 to 78, while the dropout rate fell by 40%. 请用一个原因(不超过25词)合理解释这一变化。
answer: Online learning gave flexible access to recorded lectures and personalised feedback, helping weaker students catch up and reducing their likelihood of dropping out.
solution: 需提出一个能同时解释分数提高和辍学率下降的因果机制,例如个性化辅导、灵活性、回看便利等。避免仅停留在现象描述。

stem: 下列句子中,使用隐喻(metaphor)的一句是：
options: A. She is as brave as a lion.
B. The flowers nodded in the wind.
C. The internet is an ocean of information.
D. I've told you a thousand times.
solution: C项信息是海洋将抽象信息比作海洋,是隐喻;A项明喻(人),B项拟人(D),D项夸张。故选C。

stem: 请用英文写出2个与时间相关的隐喻句(每句不超过15词)。
answer: 1) Time is money — spend it wisely. 2) Time is a river — it never flows back.
solution: 需体现A is B的隐喻结构,且与时间主题契合。避免写成明喻(as ... as time)。
writing_prompt: 请用英文写出2个与时间相关的隐喻句(每句不超过15词)。

stem: 在描述想象场景时,下列动词最能传达画面感的一项是：
options: A. The dawn light glimmered through the curtains, painting golden patterns on the floor.
B. The morning was nice.
C. It was early.
D. The curtains were there.
solution: A项glimmered金辉闪烁营造出强烈的视觉画面感;B、C项过于平淡;D项were无画面感。故选A。

stem: 请用50词以内写一段想象中的2070年的校园画面,含至少两个细节描写。
answer: In 2070, holographic teachers float in the air while students explore Mars terrain via VR desks. The cafeteria grows vegetables on the walls, and the bell is replaced by a soft chime that only those inside can hear.
solution: 需含具体细节(全息教师、VR火星、墙壁蔬菜、柔和铃声),用感官动词描绘画面,避免抽象概括。
writing_prompt: 请用50词以内写一段想象中的2070年的校园画面,含至少两个细节描写。

stem: 下列对高中生是否应该带手机入校园的评论中,立场鲜明、论证充分的一项是：
options: A. I firmly believe that mobile phones should be banned on campus. First, they distract students from learning. Second, prolonged screen time harms their eyesight.
B. Some people say phones are bad; others say they are good. It is hard to say.
C. Should phones be banned? What do you think?
D. Phones are popular.
solution: A项明确表达应该禁用立场,并给出两点理由(分散注意力+影响视力);B项立场模糊;C项以提问回避立场;D项无具体理由。故选A。

stem: 请以On the Importance of Reading Classics为题,写一段立场鲜明的评论(80词以内)。
answer: Reading classics is essential, not optional. Classics condense humanity's deepest reflections on life, morality and beauty, broadening our minds beyond the limits of our own experience. Without classics, our thinking becomes shallow and our language loses depth.
solution: 需含明确立场(essential)+ 至少两点理由(思想深度/语言积累)+ 反驳对立面(without classics...)。注意使用condense / broaden等reflect类动词。
writing_prompt: 请以On the Importance of Reading Classics为题,写一段立场鲜明的评论(80词以内)。

stem: 在向同学指出错误时,下列表达最委婉的一项是：
options: A. I'm not entirely sure, but perhaps it might be a small typo here. What do you think?
B. You made a mistake! Fix it!
C. Do it again from the beginning, immediately!
D. How could you be so careless?
solution: A项I'm not sure, but perhaps...使用模糊语可能/或许 + 征询意见,最委婉;B、D项过于直接;C项命令式语气。故选A。

stem: 将下列直接表达改写为委婉表达:Your plan is terrible and won't work. → ______
answer: I'm not sure this approach may work as well as we hope; perhaps we could explore some alternatives.
solution: 用I'm not sure / perhaps / could模糊语替代terrible / won't work,缓和批评,保留尊重。
writing_prompt: 将下列直接表达改写为委婉表达:Your plan is terrible and won't work. → ______

stem: 请用50词以内总结你认为最有效的英语词汇学习方法。
answer: I learn vocabulary by topic-based chunks rather than isolated words, review them in context (听写、复述、写作), and keep a vocabulary notebook with example sentences and personal reflections.
solution: 要点:方法(topic-based chunks)+ 复习机制(context)+ 工具(notebook with example sentences)。避免只说多背多记。
writing_prompt: 请用50词以内总结你认为最有效的英语词汇学习方法。

stem: 阅读:Social media use among 13–18 year-olds rose 28% from 2015 to 2020, with daily screen time averaging 4.6 hours by 2020. 在重组信息时,最适合作为分类维度的是：
options: A. 按用户情绪分类
C. 按国家地区分类
D. 按用户性别分类
solution: B项按年龄段与年份是最直接的分类维度,便于趋势对比;A项情绪分类不适合数据;C项按地区原文未提;D项错按性别。故选B。

stem: 假设你收集了5个关于气候变化的事实片段,请用30个词以内说明你将如何分类与重组。
answer: I will group them by cause (emissions, deforestation) and effect (sea-level rise, extreme weather), then summarise each group under a clear sub-heading.
solution: 需说明分类维度(cause/effect)+ 重组方式(分组+小标题)。避免笼统说分类整理。
writing_prompt: 假设你收集了5个关于气候变化的事实片段,请用30个词以内说明你将如何分类与重组。

stem: 在英美文化中,拜访老师办公室时,下列行为最得体的一项是：
options: A. Knock first, wait to be invited in, briefly state the purpose, and ask if the teacher has time.
B. Walk in and sit down casually.
C. Don't wait for invitation; sit down immediately.
D. Bring an expensive gift to show respect.
solution: A项先敲门、说明来意,符合英美office hours文化;B项随意入座违反礼仪;C项立即坐下不礼貌;D项送昂贵礼物超出学生身份且不符合文化习惯。故选A。

stem: 请用30词以内说明英美人在收到礼物时为何常当场打开并表达感谢。
answer: Opening the gift in front of the giver shows appreciation and interest; expressing thanks verbally reinforces the giver's thoughtfulness and the relationship.
solution: 要点:当场打开(shows appreciation/in interest)+ 口头感谢(reinforces relationship)。注意英美与中式不当面打开的差异。
writing_prompt: 请用30词以内说明英美人在收到礼物时为何常当场打开并表达感谢。

stem: 请用30词以内谈谈如何保持持久的英语学习动力。
answer: Set small weekly goals, track them in a learning journal, and reward myself with a favourite English movie or book after each milestone reached.
solution: 需含具体可操作机制(weekly goals + journal + reward),避免空洞说教。
writing_prompt: 请用30词以内谈谈如何保持持久的英语学习动力。

stem: 下列抽象学术概念词的释义最准确的一项是：
options: A. paradigm — a typical example or pattern of something; a model.
B. methodology — the study of all methods across all sciences.
C. empirical — based on theory rather than observation or experience.
D. heuristic — derived by deduction rather than trial-and-error.
solution: A项paradigm意为范式、典范,符合学术语境;B、C、D项均错:methodology不是方法论的最广义,empirical不是理论的,heuristic不是演绎的。故选A。

stem: 填空:The professor gave a clear ______ (definition) of the term before discussing its implications.
solution: def前有形容词clear,填definition。注意区别def与define的词形变化。

stem: 下列哪个词不属于科技伦理主题词群?
options: A. gene editing
B. AI decision-making
C. data privacy
D. nutrition
solution: D项nutrition(营养)属于健康/饮食主题,与科技伦理无关;A、B、C项均与科技伦理相关(基因编辑、AI决策、隐私)。故选D。

stem: 请围绕人工智能与教育主题列出5个词块(英文+中文)。
answer: 1) adaptive learning 自适应学习;2) personalised feedback 个性化反馈;3) learning analytics 学习分析;4) virtual teaching assistant 虚拟助教;5) ethical concerns 伦理关切
solution: 需为该主题相关词块,避免孤立单词。词块可包含形容词+名词、动词+名词、名词+名词组合。

stem: 下列句子时态使用错误的一项是：
options: A. I have lived here for ten years.
B. She was reading when the phone rang.
C. By the time you arrive, I will finish dinner.
D. He said he had already left.
solution: C项By next year与将来完成时will have finished匹配,但主语I与主句将完成...,未矛盾;A项现在完成时正确;B、D项语境与时态匹配。再仔细检查:C项By the time you arrive, I will finish dinner.,主句应用将来完成时will have finished而非will finish;故选C。

stem: 用恰当时态填空:By the end of next month, we ______ (complete) the project.
solution: by the end of next month表到下个月末为止,主句应用将来完成时will have completed。

stem: 下列主谓一致使用正确的一项是：
options: A. The number of students are increasing.
B. The teacher with his students is preparing for the contest.
C. Each of the students have finished the homework.
D. One of the students who studies in Japan come from Beijing.
solution: B项主语The teacher with his students中心词为The teacher(单数),谓语用单数;A、C、D项均有误:A项主语The number of...用单数;C项each of...用单数;D项one of the students who...中定语从句谓语与students一致(复数),但题面写uses不对应;故选B。

stem: 填空:Not only the teacher but also the students ______ (be) interested in the topic.
solution: Not only...but also...连接两个主语时,谓语遵循就近原则,与最近的主语the students一致,用are。

stem: 下列冠词使用正确的一项是：
options: A. She plays piano very well.
B. He wants to be a teacher in the future.
C. I had an useful experience last summer.
D. He is an university student.
solution: B项play the piano(乐器前用定冠词)正确;A项the United States国名前加the;D项an honest man为元音音素开头的词用an;A项errand拼写错;故选B。

stem: 填空:______ (The / A) United Kingdom is made up of four countries.
solution: 国名the United Kingdom/United States/Netherlands等含合众/联合概念的国名前加the;单独的国名(如China, France)不加冠词。

stem: 向教授请求推荐信时,下列表达语气最恰当的一项是：
options: A. Write me a recommendation letter right now.
B. Would you be so kind as to write a recommendation letter for me? I would be most grateful.
C. I beg you to write the letter, sir.
D. Hello professor, I am writing to ask you about something that I think might interest you and that...
solution: B项礼貌、明确,给教授留出余地;A项过于强硬;C项过于卑微;D项拖沓冗长。故选B。

stem: 将下列句子语气由弱到强排列(数字1-4表示由弱到强):A) I think maybe we should reconsider. B) We must reconsider now. C) Could we possibly reconsider? D) I strongly suggest we reconsider.
solution: 语气由弱到强:C项could we possibly...最弱;A项I think maybe...次弱;D项I strongly suggest较强;B项We must...最强。
writing_prompt: 将下列句子语气由弱到强排列(数字1-4表示由弱到强):A) I think maybe we should reconsider. B) We must reconsider now. C) Could we possibly reconsider? D) I strongly suggest we reconsider.

stem: 听力材料(原文转述):Good morning. Today I'll discuss three key factors that influence adolescent sleep — biological rhythms, academic pressure, and screen exposure. I'll first present data from a 2022 longitudinal study of 1,200 students, then discuss each factor in turn. 该讲座的主旨(Main Idea)是：
options: A. 2022年某项睡眠研究的实验方法。
B. 探讨影响青少年睡眠的三大因素(生物节律、学业压力、屏幕使用)。
C. 呼吁学生减少屏幕使用时间。
D. 介绍青少年失眠的治疗方法。
solution: B项探讨影响青少年睡眠的三大因素贴合讲座主旨;A、C、D项均为细节目录,非主旨。故选B。

stem: 承接上一节听力讲座。下列细节(Detail)信息中,最有可能在讲座中被重点展开的是：
options: A. 演讲者本人的教学经历。
B. 听众的背景与兴趣。
C. 屏幕暴露对褪黑素分泌及入睡时间影响的具体数据。
D. 学校图书馆的开放时间。
solution: C项屏幕暴露的具体影响与数据对应讲座中第三因素,最可能被详述;A、B、D项均为引入背景,非重点展开。故选C。

stem: 听力材料(原文转述):Affirmative: We should ban smartphones in schools because they distract students. Negative: But banning them is unrealistic; better to teach responsible use. 两方立场的核心分歧是：
options: A. 正方主张校园全面禁用手机;反方主张通过教育培养自律使用。
B. 正方关注手机价格;反方关注手机品牌。
C. 两方一致认为应在课堂上禁用手机。
D. 正方支持使用手机教学;反方反对所有教学技术。
solution: A项全面禁止 vs 教育自律准确概括两方核心分歧;B项错把焦点归为价格;C项将辩论窄化为课堂使用;D项混淆技术与教师。故选A。

stem: 承接上一节辩论。如果正方随后反驳:Research shows banning phones reduces off-task behaviour by 35%. 这一反驳最直接针对的反方观点是：
options: A. 反方主张手机有教育价值。
B. 反方认为全面禁用在现实中不可行。
C. 反方认为手机对学生视力有害。
D. 反方主张学生应拥有选择权。
solution: B项反对全面禁用 + 反方认为不可行;正方用数据证明禁令有效,直接驳斥可行性论点;A、C、D项与可行性论据无关。故选B。

stem: 听力材料(原文转述):At Thanksgiving, families gather around the table to give thanks. They share stories, eat turkey, and watch the Macy's parade. 下列对thanksgiving的理解最准确的一项是：
options: A. 类似中国春节,主张燃放烟火。
B. 美国传统节日,家人团聚、表达感恩、共食火鸡。
C. 仅是商业促销节日,无家庭元素。
D. 仅是宗教节日,与家庭无关。
solution: B项家人团聚、表达感恩、共享火鸡贴合美国感恩节文化内涵;A项误读为圣诞节;C、D项混淆文化内涵。故选B。

stem: 假设你在听力中听到 speaker 说:He is a real Scrooge when it comes to tipping. 请用30词以内解释Scrooge的文化含义。
answer: Scrooge comes from Dickens' A Christmas Carol, meaning a miserly person. Here it implies he tips very poorly out of stinginess, a culturally loaded criticism.
solution: 需点明Scrooge出处(Dickens/《圣诞颂歌》)、字面义(吝啬鬼)、句中音义(给小费少)。
writing_prompt: 假设你在听力中听到 speaker 说:He is a real Scrooge when it comes to tipping. 请用30词以内解释Scrooge的文化含义。

stem: 听讲座时,对Three factors → 1) rhythm 2) pressure 3) screen这段要点,最适合的速记符号是：
answer: 3 factors: ① rhythm ② pressure ③ screen
solution: 用箭头 + 数字编号 + 缩写,是结构化速记常见方式。注意避免冗长的句子记录。

stem: 听力速记中,下列符号最适合替代 increase / rise 的是：
solution: C项↑表示上升/增加;A项↓下降;B项=等于;D项×错误。故选C。

stem: 阅读学术摘要:Aim: To investigate the effect of sleep on memory consolidation. Method: 60 participants were divided into sleep and no-sleep conditions. Result: Sleep group recalled 27% more items. Conclusion: Sleep significantly enhances memory consolidation. 该研究最可能的局限(Limitation)是：
options: A. 样本量较小(仅60人)且未提及随机分组与控制变量。
B. 实验结论清晰肯定。
C. 实验方法简洁。
D. 实验结果支持假设。
solution: A项样本量小且未提及随机分组是最明显的局限;B、C、D项均为正向结果。故选A。

stem: 用30词以内写上题摘要的内容概要(Main Idea)。
answer: This study finds that sleep significantly boosts memory consolidation — participants who slept recalled 27% more items than those who did not.
solution: 需覆盖目的+结果+结论;控制在30词以内。
writing_prompt: 用30词以内写上题摘要的内容概要(Main Idea)。

stem: 段落:Online education has expanded rapidly. Many students now learn through apps. However, prolonged screen time can cause eye strain. Schools should therefore limit daily screen hours. 该段落的逻辑结构属于：
options: A. 总分总
B. 现象—原因—建议
C. 时间顺序
D. 对比论证
solution: B项现象—原因—建议贴合现象(在线教育扩张)→ 原因(屏幕时间导致眼疲劳)→ 建议的递进;A、C项顺序不符;D项对比无对比对象。故选B。

stem: 请用30词以内概括上段落的隐性逻辑衔接逻辑链。
answer: Online education expands → screen time rises → eye strain worsens → schools must limit hours (cause–effect chain).
solution: 要点:扩张 → 屏幕增加 → 眼疲劳 → 限制时长,体现因果链。
writing_prompt: 请用30词以内概括上段落的隐性逻辑衔接逻辑链。

stem: 假设你被要求就My Favourite Way of Relieving Stress作60秒即兴演讲,请写出50词以内的演讲稿(含开头、要点、结尾)。
answer: Good morning, everyone. My favourite way to relieve stress is taking a quiet walk in the park. Surrounded by trees and birdsong, my mind slows down and ideas return fresh. Try it — nature is the best medicine.
solution: 需含greeting + 主题句 + 1-2点理由/细节 + 呼吁/结尾。注意口语化与节奏感。

stem: 在英语对话中,遇到听不懂对方时,最得体的修复策略是：
options: A. Sorry, could you rephrase that in simpler words? I want to make sure I understand.
B. Smile and pretend to understand.
C. Stay silent and change the topic.
D. Switch to your mother tongue immediately.
solution: A项请求对方用更简单的词重述,是得体且不冒犯的修复策略;B项假装听懂不礼貌;C项直接放弃不恰当;D项改用母语不解决沟通问题。故选A。

stem: 用30词以内写出三种在口语中修复交际障碍的方法。
answer: 1) Rephrasing: Say it differently in simpler language. 2) Examples: Give a sample to clarify. 3) Paraphrasing: Confirm understanding by restating the speaker's idea.
solution: 需列出三种策略并简述,避免只说换种说法。
writing_prompt: 用30词以内写出三种在口语中修复交际障碍的方法。

As you step into the world, carry that courage. The future is yours to write. Congratulations, class of 2026!
solution: 需含greeting(开场)+ 中段要点(回忆、感谢、价值观)+ 结尾号召(未来展望、祝贺)。注意演讲语言节奏与重复修辞。

stem: 读后续写:根据所给段落续写两段情节,使故事合理发展、情感升华(150-200词)。所给段落:On the last day of the summer camp, Lily discovered a small injured bird at the foot of the oak tree. Its wing bent unnaturally; it trembled at her touch. Paragraph 1: 续写一段Lily救助小鸟的具体行动与心理。 Paragraph 2: 续写一段离别时的情感升华(100词左右)。
answer: Paragraph 1: Lily knelt down, carefully cupping the trembling bird in both palms. She whispered softly, as if her voice were a warm blanket. Walking back to the cabin, she fetched a small box, lined it with soft cotton, and gently placed the bird inside. By nightfall, the bird had stopped trembling, though its wing still bent at an awkward angle. Lily stayed by its side until the camp counsellor persuaded her to rest. Paragraph 2: The next morning, Lily rose before dawn. As the bus pulled away, she looked back at the oak tree, and in the faint golden light, she thought she saw a small silhouette rise, spread its wings, and disappear into the waking sky. The summer had taught her that kindness, no matter how small, can mend a broken wing — and a heart.
solution: 对情节构建(具体行动+ 心理描写+ 转折)+ 情感升华(离别场景+ 主题呼应)进行评价。本范文使用carefully cupping / whispered softly / gently placed等细腻动词;用silhouette rise / disappear into the waking sky完成主题升华。
writing_prompt: 读后续写:根据所给段落续写两段情节,使故事合理发展、情感升华(150-200词)。所给段落:On the last day of the summer camp, Lily discovered a small injured bird at the foot of the oak tree. Its wing bent unnaturally; it trembled at her touch. Paragraph 1: 续写一段Lily救助小鸟的具体行动与心理。 Paragraph 2: 续写一段离别时的情感升华(100词左右)。

stem: 下列短文改错中,错误数量最多的一项是：
options: A. There are many advantages for students to take part in volunteer activities.
B. Although I am only a student, but I still want to help others. It makes me feel happy, so I will keep doing it in the future.
C. He has went abroad last year.
D. She is a teacher who is kind and is patient.
solution: B项多处错误:Although...but...不能同时使用;It makes me应用makes it;so I will保留。A项无误;C项went错为has gone;B项含错误最多。故选B。

stem: 改正下列句中错误(每词最多改一处):He suggested to go hiking on Sunday.
answer: He suggested going hiking on Sunday.
solution: suggest后接动名词,不能接不定式。suggest to do是常见错误。

stem: 阅读:The Victorian era saw rapid industrialisation. Cities expanded, railways were built, and the working class moved into factories. Living conditions were poor, but reforms gradually improved them. By the end of the era, public health and education had made significant progress. 用40词以内写出读后概述。
answer: The Victorian era witnessed rapid industrialisation and urban growth, which brought poor living conditions. Gradual reforms eventually improved public health and education, marking significant social progress.
solution: 需涵盖:时代特征(工业革命)+ 影响(城市扩张、生活条件差)+ 改革成效(公共卫生/教育进步)。控制40词以内,避免原文堆砌。
writing_prompt: 阅读:The Victorian era saw rapid industrialisation. Cities expanded, railways were built, and the working class moved into factories. Living conditions were poor, but reforms gradually improved them. By the end of the era, public health and education had made significant progress. 用40词以内写出读后概述。

stem: 在描述丝绸之路的历史意义时,下列英文表述最准确的一项是：
options: A. The Silk Road is a modern transportation network connecting China and Europe.
B. The Silk Road, an ancient trade route, facilitated cultural and economic exchanges between East and West.
C. The Silk Road only carried silk from China to Rome.
D. The Silk Road had no impact on world history.
solution: B项an ancient trade route...facilitated cultural and economic exchanges between East and West概括了丝绸之路的历史与文化意义;A项错指现代交通;C项仅说商品;D项否定性表述不当。故选B。

stem: 用50词以内说明工业革命对英国社会变迁的三大影响。
answer: 1) Urbanisation: people moved from countryside to cities. 2) New social class: industrial bourgeoisie and working class emerged. 3) Reform pressure: poor working conditions drove calls for public health and education reform.
solution: 需列出三大影响(城市化、新阶级、改革诉求),每点简洁概括。
writing_prompt: 用50词以内说明工业革命对英国社会变迁的三大影响。

stem: 下列关于可持续发展(sustainable development)的表述最准确的一项是：
options: A. Sustainable development meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
B. Sustainable development means developing the economy at all costs.
C. Sustainable development only concerns environmental protection.
D. Sustainable development means human activity should leave no impact on nature at all.
solution: A项既满足当代人需求又不损害后代满足其需求的能力贴合1987 Brundtland报告定义;B、C项过窄;D项完全无影响错误。故选A。

stem: 听力材料(原文转述):Man: I'm thinking of buying a laptop. Woman: Anything... actually I just saw the new model. 提问者选 ...(主旨题)。主旨是：
options: A. 男士打算买电脑。
B. 男士与女士讨论购买笔记本电脑。
C. 女士想买电脑。
D. 男士想买手机。
solution: B项讨论电脑购买贴合两方谈论内容;A、C、D项均非主旨。故选B。

stem: 听力材料(原文转述):Reporter: ...In short, today's lecture highlighted three major challenges facing urban transport... 请用25词以内概括这段报道的主旨。
answer: The report summarises three main challenges of urban transport highlighted in today's lecture.
solution: 主旨题答题要点:抓住首尾句+ 反复信息。需简洁概述。

stem: 完形填空:When I was a child, I ______ (1) afraid of the dark. My grandmother would sit beside my bed and tell me stories until I fell asleep. 第 (1) 空最佳选项是：
options: A. am
B. was
C. used
D. becoming
solution: B项was表过去时态,与When I was a child一致;A项am现在时;C项used不接afraid;D项becoming语法不当。故选B。

stem: 承接上文。第 (2) 空 Her voice was so gentle ______ it calmed my nerves. 最佳选项是：
options: A. that
B. which
C. what
D. because
solution: A项that引导结果状语从句;B项which非限定性定语;C项what不能引导状语;D项because表原因与句意不符。故选A。

stem: 假设你是班长,需邀请外教Mr. Smith参加班级英语晚会并致辞,请写一封80-100词的英文邀请函。
answer: Dear Mr. Smith, On behalf of Class 3, I am writing to cordially invite you to our English Evening, which will be held in the school hall at 7 p.m. on Friday, December 12. The programme includes short plays, songs and a brief speech session. We would be deeply honoured if you could attend and share a few encouraging words with our students. We look forward to your reply. Yours sincerely, Li Hua, Monitor of Class 3.
solution: 应用文要素:① 称呼(Dear...); ② 自报身份(on behalf of...); ③ 活动信息(时间地点内容); ④ 邀请与具体请求(致辞); ⑤ 期待回复; ⑥ 落款(Yours sincerely, Li Hua, Monitor)。
writing_prompt: 假设你是班长,需邀请外教Mr. Smith参加班级英语晚会并致辞,请写一封80-100词的英文邀请函。

stem: 你收到英国笔友Tom的来信,询问如何在中国过春节。请写一封80-100词的回信,介绍春节习俗并发出邀请。
answer: Dear Tom, Thank you for your interest in Chinese New Year. During the festival, families reunite, enjoy reunion dinner on Chinese New Year's Eve, give red envelopes (hongbao) to children, and watch the Spring Festival Gala. Firecrackers and lion dances fill the streets with joy. If you ever visit China, my family would love to invite you to share these traditions with us. Hope to see you soon! Best wishes, Li Hua.
solution: 回信要点:感谢+介绍春节习俗(reunion dinner / hongbao / lion dance)+ 个人邀请+ 期待。注意应用文格式与礼貌用语。
